note: Ninth shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the florist's, a glass greenhouse with cream limestone walls and a terracotta tile floor. LANDMARK: the tall palm tree over a round stone fountain under the glass dome. The doorway on the far left shows the teal fabric shop with its cloth bolts (way back); the doorway on the right opens into the dark red print room with its iron press (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right (the adjective vegetal in the centre). Zoom: the flower bed at the front left (z1).

items.scene: a FLURRY of FLOWER petals swirls round the bumblebee
the FAIRY on the toadstool sprinkles stardust over the toy village
the plump AUNT hugs her potted PLANT
a curly FERN grows in a FOOD JAR on the stool
the PLANT wall of ivy grows so TALL the gardener needs a ladder
BOO! the ghost pops up behind the BOUQUET: OK?
the white LILY stands tall in its pot as if it had a LEASE on the place
the pink tulips stand in a painted jug VASE
the girl with ROSY cheeks smells the ROSEBUSH on the trellis
